unmatched_domains.name: product delivery tooling (an AI-assisted software delivery framework's own product model)
unmatched_domains.why: Garura is a framework for building software with AI agents; the field it serves is software delivery and product management, and the job here is keeping its product model linked. None of the ten shelves (analytics, collaboration, content-management, ecommerce, experience, marketing, notifications, payments, personalization, user-management) has a trigger about modelling a product or planning delivery work.
